```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

allotjaments <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/allotjaments-vila-seca-convencionals.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

d <- aggregate(
  as.numeric(as.character(total_places)) ~ tipus_establiment,
  data = allotjaments,
  FUN = sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
names(d) <- c("tipus", "places")
d$tipus <- factor(
  d$tipus,
  levels = c("Hotels", "Càmpings", "Apartaments Turístics", "Autocaravanes")
)
d <- d[!is.na(d$tipus), ]
d <- d[order(d$places, decreasing = TRUE), ]

## Layout squarified per a un treemap (algorisme constructiu senzill)
squarify <- function(areas, x0 = 0, y0 = 0, w = 1, h = 1) {
  areas <- sort(areas, decreasing = TRUE)
  total <- sum(areas)
  n <- length(areas)
  sx <- x0
  sy <- y0
  sw <- w
  sh <- h
  out <- data.frame(x = numeric(0), y = numeric(0), w = numeric(0), h = numeric(0))
  i <- 1
  while (i <= n) {
    ## orientació segons el costat més llarg
    if (sw >= sh) {
      ## fila horitzontal: cada cel·la ocupa l'alçada proporcional
      remaining <- areas[i:n]
      row_sum <- sum(remaining)
      row_h <- sh
      each_w <- remaining * sw / row_sum
      cx <- sx
      for (k in seq_len(n - i + 1)) {
        out <- rbind(out, data.frame(x = cx, y = sy, w = each_w[k], h = row_h))
        cx <- cx + each_w[k]
      }
      break
    } else {
      ## columna vertical: cada cel·la ocupa l'amplada proporcional
      remaining <- areas[i:n]
      row_sum <- sum(remaining)
      row_w <- sw
      each_h <- remaining * sh / row_sum
      cy <- sy
      for (k in seq_len(n - i + 1)) {
        out <- rbind(out, data.frame(x = sx, y = cy, w = row_w, h = each_h[k]))
        cy <- cy + each_h[k]
      }
      break
    }
  }
  out
}

## assignem àrees proporcionals a les places (escala en píxels lògics)
sc <- squarify(d$places, 0, 0, 100, 61)
d$x <- sc$x; d$y <- sc$y; d$w <- sc$w; d$h <- sc$h

pal <- c(
  "Hotels" = "#2171b5",
  "Càmpings" = "#6b8fb5",
  "Apartaments Turístics" = "#a9c4e0",
  "Autocaravanes" = "#d3dce0"
)

fig <- ggplot(d, aes(xmin = x, ymin = y, xmax = x + w, ymax = y + h)) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(fill = tipus),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = x + w / 2, y = y + h / 2, label = sprintf("%s\n%d places", tipus, places)),
    size = 3.3,
    color = "#ffffff",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Places d'allotjament per tipus d'establiment a Vila-seca",
    caption = "Font: registre d'allotjaments de la costa de Vila-seca (dades de la pràctica), total de places."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/treemap-allotjament-vilaseca.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 6, device = svglite::svglite)
```
